title: Ghost Courier
subtitle: Borrow a route from your past self.
description: An original isometric time-loop heist through a nocturnal clockwork city. Outwit a model-powered warden with recorded echoes, pressure switches, readable patrols, and three replayable courier cases.
instruction: Connect a model to begin. Record a route to a relay, rewind to leave your echo holding it, then carry a stolen parcel past the warden. Local moves advance the clock; the model replans only between loops.
